desc:
Do you enjoy awesome cutscenes and story, obby and parkour, or beating monsters and bosses? Then this game is for you.

There was an X-Ray explosion in the Dental Clinic, turning most people into monsters. You have survived by hiding in the freezer, but this is only just the beginning. You will have to fight your way out!

Latest update - November 21 2025
- You can now buy 30 second invulnerability shield after dying
- Made final boss easier

This game features:
- Engaging parkour
- Various interactions with the environment
- Numerous enemies
- Combo attacks
- Several types of weapons
- Upgrades
- Epic boss fights
- Awesome cutscenes
- Hidden secret chests all over the game
